if not record.completed: return # Only act when milestone is completed
project = record.project_id if not project: return
# Count remaining incomplete milestones incomplete = env['project.milestone'].search_count([ ('project_id', '=', project.id), ('completed', '=', False), ])
# ─── Case: All milestones done ─── if incomplete == 0: # Mark project as completed project.write({'stage_id': env.ref('project.project_project_stage_3', raise_if_not_found=False).id if env.ref('project.project_project_stage_3', raise_if_not_found=False) else False})
# Send project completion email completed_template = env.ref('hexa_studio.hexa_project_completed_email', raise_if_not_found=False) if completed_template and project.partner_id and project.partner_id.email: completed_template.send_mail(project.id, force_send=True)
# Create final milestone invoice (account.move) # Use the project's x_hexa_budget if available invoice_amount = project.x_hexa_budget or 0.0 if invoice_amount > 0 and project.partner_id: # Find default invoice journal journal = env['account.journal'].search([('type', '=', 'sale')], limit=1) if journal: invoice_vals = { 'move_type': 'out_invoice', 'partner_id': project.partner_id.id, 'journal_id': journal.id, 'invoice_date': fields.Date.today(), 'invoice_line_ids': [(0, 0, { 'name': f'Final Milestone Payment — {project.name}', 'quantity': 1, 'price_unit': invoice_amount, })], 'ref': f'HEXA-{project.name[:20]}', } invoice = env['account.move'].create(invoice_vals)
# Post a message on the project project.message_post( body=f'Final invoice {invoice.name} created for amount {invoice_amount:,.2f}.', message_type='comment', )
# ─── Case: Some milestones still incomplete (just a progress update) ─── else: milestone_template = env.ref('hexa_studio.hexa_milestone_email', raise_if_not_found=False) if milestone_template and project.partner_id and project.partner_id.email: milestone_template.send_mail(project.id, force_send=True)
# Update project progress total = env['project.milestone'].search_count([('project_id', '=', project.id)]) completed_count = total - incomplete # Log progress internally project.message_post( body=f'Milestone "{record.name}" completed. Progress: {completed_count}/{total} milestones.', message_type='notification', )
